title: Dancing Skeletons
sentences: After the plague, European art filled up with dancing skeletons.
It was called the Danse Macabre, the Dance of Death.
Skeletons led kings, bishops, merchants and farmers in a line.
Death comes for everyone, rich or poor.
One famous version was painted in Paris in 1424.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
